    body::Body,

    response::{Html, IntoResponse, Response},
    routing::{get, post},
    Router,
};

use std::net::{IpAddr, Ipv4Addr, SocketAddr};
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::fs;
use tower_http::trace::TraceLayer;

mod cli;
mod server;
mod handlers;
mod auth;
mod utils;

use cli::Args;
use server::AppState;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let args = Args::parse();
    
    // Initialize logging if verbose
    if args.verbose {
        env_logger::builder()
            .filter_level(log::LevelFilter::Info)
            .try_init()
            .ok();
    }
    
    // Determine the path to serve
    let serve_path = if let Some(path) = &args.path {
        PathBuf::from(path)
    } else {
        std::env::current_dir()?
    };
    
    // Verify path exists
    if !serve_path.exists() {
        eprintln!("Error: Path does not exist: {:?}", serve_path);
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    
    // Parse interfaces
    let interfaces = parse_interfaces(&args.interfaces);
    
    // Create app state
    let state = Arc::new(AppState {
        serve_path: serve_path.clone(),
        auth: args.auth.clone(),
        index: args.index.clone(),
        spa: args.spa,
        verbose: args.verbose,
        port: args.port,
        color_scheme: args.color_scheme.clone(),
        color_scheme_dark: args.color_scheme_dark.clone(),
        title: args.title.clone(),
        hide_version_footer: args.hide_version_footer,
        hide_theme_selector: args.hide_theme_selector,
        default_sorting_method: args.default_sorting_method.clone(),
        default_sorting_order: args.default_sorting_order.clone(),
        dirs_first: args.dirs_first,
    });
    
    // Build router
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/", get(handlers::root))
        .route("/*path", get(handlers::serve_file))
        .layer(TraceLayer::new_for_http())
        .with_state(state);
    
    // Create socket address
    let addr = SocketAddr::new(
        interfaces.get(0).copied().unwrap_or(IpAddr::from(Ipv4Addr::new(0, 0, 0, 0))),
        args.port,
